description_en: Queries the advanced mitigation logs of Anti-DDoS Premium
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（国际）的高级防护日志
name: DescribeDefenseRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

查询时间的跨度不允许超过近90天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

查询时间的跨度不允许超过90天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 页面显示的记录数量。最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size

AttackPeak.description_en: The peak attack throughput. Unit: bps

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the mitigation. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 防护结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the mitigation. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 防护开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The status of advanced mitigation. Valid values:

0: in use

1: ended
Status.description_zh:
高级防护的状态。取值：
0：使用中
1：已使用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of advanced mitigation records
